alert_id.description: The unique identifier of the alert being processed.

classification.description: Verdict on the nature of the alert.

confidence_score.description: Confidence in the classification and proposed actions.

enrichment_data.description: Key pieces of context gathered during triage (e.g., threat intel findings, asset info).

proposed_actions.description: List of actions the agent proposes to take or recommends.

escalate_to_ir.description: Whether this alert should be escalated to the Incident Response agent.

escalation_reason.description: Reason for escalation, if escalate_to_ir is true.
